messages.content: We are building a local conversation memory and recovery system for a lab demonstration.
Store conversation data in SQLite and do not send it to hosted APIs.
One option is to send each conversation to a hosted LLM for summarization.
I disagree with sending conversations to a hosted LLM. I reject that suggestion. All conversation processing must stay local.
We will use SQLite for persistent storage and local rule-based extraction for the lab demo.
Every saved memory must keep a reference to its source message.
Requirement: Keep explicit disagreements and unresolved questions separate from confirmed decisions.
We still need to decide whether an optional local importance model improves memory quality.
Next, validate recovery using the stored memories without rereading the transcript.
